ane: aver — they have (present 3rd pl. an + paragogic -e, the epic final e in á-e assonance; perfect auxiliary: so consejo preso ane 'they have taken their counsel, made up their minds'; = han)
saludadnos: saludar + nos — greet (for) us (imperative 2nd pl. saludad + enclitic nos, 'on our behalf'; saludadnos a mio Çid 'give the Cid our greetings'; = saludadnos)
bivare: Bivar — Vivar (Bivar + paragogic -e, Pidal's restored final e in á-e assonance; el de Bivare 'the one of Vivar'; = Vivar)
fare: fazer — to do (short infinitive far + paragogic -e in á-e assonance; quanto lo podemos fare 'as much as we can do'; = hacer)
perderave: perder — he will lose (future 3rd sg.; Pidal: 'perderave por perderá, con e paragógica', the e with a v glide restored by him in italics; nada non perderave 'he will lose nothing'; = perderá)
pesare: pesar — to grieve, weigh upon (infinitive + paragogic -e in á-e assonance; non me a por qué pesare 'I have no cause to be grieved'; = pesar)
tórnansse: tornar + se — they go back, return (present 3rd pl. tornan + reflexive se, spelt -ss-; tórnansse los iffantes 'the infantes turn back'; = se tornan)
quandol: quando + le — when … him (quando + le, the -e of le dropped; quandol vieron assomar 'when they saw him appear'; = cuando le)
assomar: assomar — to appear, come into view (infinitive; vieron assomar 'they saw (him) appear'; = asomar)
deçido: deçir — come down, dismounted (past part.; ser + participle as perfect of a verb of motion: Deçido es Minaya 'Minaya has dismounted'; Pidal: 'descendido' del caballo, compare diçiendo del cavallo; = descendido)
ssan: santo — Saint (apocopated before a name, spelt with doubled s; a ssan Pero 'to Saint Peter'; = san)
acabó: acabar — he finished (preterite 3rd sg.; quando acabó la oraçión 'when he had finished the prayer'; = acabó)
omillom: omillar + me — I humble myself, I bow to (present 1st sg. omillo + enclitic me, the e dropped before the next word: omíllome; Omillom, doña Ximena 'I bow to you, doña Ximena', a courtly greeting; = me humillo)
ffaga: fazer — may (he) do (likewise) (present subjunctive 3rd sg., ff = f; Pidal: a 'verbo vicario' standing for the verb before it, assi ffaga 'también curie', 'may he guard them too'; = haga)
salúdavos: saludar + vos — greets you (present 3rd sg. salúda + enclitic vos; Salúdavos mio Çid 'the Cid sends you greetings'; = os saluda)
onde: onde — where, whence (relative adverb; allá onde elle está 'there where he is'; = donde)
dexé: dexar — I left (preterite 1st sg.; sano lo dexé 'I left him well'; = dejé)
sueltas: soltar — released, set free (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with the object; sueltas me vos ha, Pidal 'os ha dejado libres', 'he has let you go free (into my charge)'; = sueltas)
levaros: levar + vos — to take you (infinitive levar + enclitic vos, contracted to -ros; por levaros a Valençia 'in order to take you to Valencia'; = llevaros)
heredad: heredad — inherited holding, estate, landed property (por heredad 'as a possession'; = heredad)
sanas: sano — sound, unharmed, healthy (fem. pl.; sanas e sin mal 'safe and unharmed'; = sanas)
enviólos: enviar + los — he sent them (preterite 3rd sg. envió + enclitic los; = los envió)
dezid: dezir — say, tell (imperative 2nd pl.; Dezid al Canpeador 'tell the Campeador'; = decid)
fóremos: seer / ir — we shall be, go (future subjunctive 1st pl., Pidal's restored f[ó]remos; mientra que fóremos por sus tierras 'while we travel through his lands'; seer and ir share this stem; = fuéremos)
curiare: curiar — he should guard (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si Dios nos curiare de mal 'if God keeps us from harm'; no modern curiar, = guardare)
sermos: seer — we shall be (future 1st pl., a rare shortened form beside seremos, its exact formation uncertain; sermos i 'we shall be there'; = seremos)
penssarán: pensar — they will see to, take care of (future 3rd pl.; e dello penssarán, Pidal 'y cuidarán de ello'; = pensarán)
remaneçió: remaneçer — he remained, stayed behind (preterite 3rd sg.; remaneçió en San Pero 'he stayed on at San Pedro'; = permaneció, quedó)
irse: ir + se — to go away, set off (infinitive + reflexive se; irse quieren 'they wish to be off'; = irse)
toviesse: tener — he might hold, keep (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; que les toviesse pro 'that he should look after their interests, be of use to them'; the exact force of tener pro is uncertain; = tuviese)
rogavan: rogar — they were begging (imperfect 3rd pl.; = rogaban)
diziendo: dezir — saying (gerund; diziendo Minaya 'Minaya says', the gerund standing for a finite verb of speech; = diciendo)
feré: fazer — I shall do (future 1st sg.; esto feré 'I shall do this'; = haré)
acreçídol: acreçer + le — increased (to him) (past part. acreçído + enclitic le, the e dropped; acreçídol han 'have added to his company', i.e. le han acrecido; = acrecido)
aduxiera: aduzir — he had brought (3rd sg. -ra form with pluperfect value, strong preterite stem adux- (aduxo); que aduxiera d'allá 'whom he had brought from there'; = había traído)
pensólas: pensar + las — he set about (equipping) them (preterite 3rd sg. pensó + enclitic las; pensólas de adobar 'he set about fitting them out', pensar de + inf., las the object of adobar; = se puso a adobarlas)
mejores: mejor — better, best (pl.; de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment'; = mejores)
guarnimientos: guarnimiento — clothing and finery, attire (pl.; Pidal: 'vestidos y aderezo de una persona'; de los mejores guarnimientos 'with the finest attire'; = atavíos)
parescan: parescer — they may seem, look (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; que non parescan mal 'so that they may not look poor'; = parezcan)
adobadas: adobar — fitted out, equipped (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with the object; las ha adobadas 'has fitted them out'; = adobadas, aderezadas)
desfechos: desfazer — undone, ruined (past part. masc. pl.; Desfechos nos ha el Çid 'the Cid has ruined us'; = deshechos)
soltariemos: soltar — we would release, give up (conditional 1st pl.; soltariemos la ganançia 'we would give up the interest'; = soltaríamos)
cosiment: cosiment — favour, grace; reward (Pidal: 'merced, favor'; buen cosiment y avrá, 'habrá buen pago', 'there will be good reward for it'; no modern descendant)
dexaremos: dexar — we shall leave (future 1st pl.; dexaremos Burgos 'we shall leave Burgos'; = dejaremos)
acogen: acoger — they join, gather to (present 3rd pl.; reflexive acogerse a uno 'to come over to someone, join his following': muchas yentes se le acogen 'many people join him'; = se le unen)
besad: besar — kiss (imperative 2nd pl.; las manos le besad 'kiss his hands'; = besad)
olbidar: olbidar — to forget (infinitive, spelt with b for v; no lo quiera olbidar 'let him not forget'; = olvidar)
levarlo: levar + lo — to carry it (infinitive + enclitic lo; en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward, promoting it'; = llevarlo)
espiden: espedir — they take leave (present 3rd pl., reflexive; yas espiden 'now they take their leave', the se in yas; = se despiden)
felos: fe + los — behold them (presentative, as in afevos, + enclitic los; felos en Medina las dueñas 'there they are at Medina, the ladies and Álvar Fáñez'; = helos aquí)

__broaden__.val: valer — help! (imperative 2nd sg., apocopated for vale; = vale) · val — valley (noun, = valle; el val de río Martín 'the valley of the river Martín') · also valer — he helps, avails (present 3rd sg., apocopated for vale; si no nos val 'if he does not help us'; = vale)
__broaden__.lieva: levar — he carries off (present 3rd sg.; = lleva) · also levar — he brings, leads (present 3rd sg.; si Dios me lieva allá 'if God brings me there'; = lleva)
__broaden__.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de)
__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué)
__broaden__.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession')
__broaden__.en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men') · also en + infinitive 'in (doing)' (en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward'); en çinco días 'in five days'
__broaden__.cabdal: cabdal — chief, principal (adjective; seña cabdal 'the chief banner'; = caudal as 'principal', now mainly a noun 'wealth, flow') · also cabdal — principal, capital sum (noun; que nos diesse el cabdal 'that he give us the principal'; = caudal)
__broaden__.pesar: pesar — grief, sorrow (noun; = pesar) · also pesar — to grieve (infinitive; non me a por qué pesar 'there is nothing to grieve me in it'; = pesar)
__broaden__.mande: mandar — I command, I order (present subjunctive 1st sg.; fata que yo lo mande 'until I order it'; = mande) · also mandar — may he grant, ordain (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; el Criador lo mande 'may the Creator so ordain'; = mande)
__broaden__.mi: mi — my (unstressed possessive) · also mi — me (stressed pronoun after a preposition; por mi 'on my behalf'; = mí)
__broaden__.aguardar: aguardar — to watch, keep watch on (infinitive; mandó aguardar 'ordered (him) watched'; = aguardar) · also aguardar — to guard, serve and attend (Pidal: 'igual que guardar, servir y atender'; que los ha de aguardar 'who is to look after them on the road'; = guardar, atender)
__broaden__.quiera: querer — may (it) wish, be about to (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quiera) · also bien querer 'to wish well, be kindly disposed' (que bien nos quiera 'who wishes us well')
__broaden__.tenié: tener — he had, was mounted on (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; que tenié buen cavallo 'who had a good horse'; = tenía) · also tener — he held, kept under his power (en su mano tenié a Çelfa 'he held Çelfa in his hand'; = tenía) · also se tenié — he had with him (reflexive; e él se tenié çiento 'and he had a hundred of his own'; = tenía consigo)
__broaden__.veré: veer — I shall see (future 1st sg.; = veré) · also veer con — to see to (a matter) with (lo veré con el Çid 'I shall take it up with the Cid')
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment')
__broaden__.preso: prender — taken (past part.; grand aver avemos preso 'we have taken great wealth'; = preso, prendido) · also so consejo preso ane 'they have taken their counsel, have resolved'
__broaden__.dio: dar — he gave, struck (preterite 3rd sg.; un colpe dio 'he struck a blow'; = dio) · dar a + inf. 'to give (something) to be …-ed' (Dio a partir estos dineros 'he had this money shared out') · also dar — he dispatched, sent (Pidal: 'despachó, envió'; Dio tres cavalleros 'he dispatched three knights'; = envió)
